threads.body: `moonshot_ai` is being added as a new well-known value for `gen_ai.provider.name`, but there is no corresponding reference scenario / reference output demonstrating this provider value being emitted (no `moonshot`/`moonshot_ai` occurrences under `reference/`). Repo guidance expects convention changes under `model/` or `docs/` to be paired with a `reference/scenarios/` update to demonstrate capturability (see `.github/copilot-instructions.md:30-31`). Please add a scenario (or extend an existing one) that credibly emits `gen_ai.provider.name=moonshot_ai`, or document why this is a capture gap.
